tool.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking
tool.summary: Experimental reasoning edition of Gemini 2.0 Flash that outputs chain-of-thought steps for visual and logical problem-solving.
tool.architecture: Multimodal MoE with explicit reasoning tokens and reflection loops.
tool.usage:
from google import genai
client = genai.Client()
response = client.models.generate_content(
  model="gemini-2.0-flash-thinking-exp",
  contents="Solve this physics circuit diagram problem."
)
tool.limitations: Experimental model with dynamic rate limits.
